name: USD SOFR Fixing and Value-Date Calendar
notes: Treasury repo reference-rate calendar, distinct from Federal Reserve banking days (usny) and bond trading sessions (sifma). Full repo-market closures have no SOFR on or for that date; the preceding business-day fixing carries across the closure. Good Friday remains a closure even when government securities trade an early-close session, as confirmed for 2021, 2023 and 2026. New Year's Day and Veterans Day have no Friday substitute for Saturday holidays; Independence Day, Christmas and Juneteenth (from 2022) do. Sources: <https://www.newyorkfed.org/markets/reference-rates/additional-information-about-reference-rates>, <https://www.newyorkfed.org/markets/opolicy/operating_policy_250328a>, <https://www.newyorkfed.org/markets/opolicy/operating_policy_260312a>, <https://www.newyorkfed.org/markets/opolicy/operating_policy_260618a>, <https://www.newyorkfed.org/markets/opolicy/operating_policy_181204>. SOFR first value date was 2018-04-02. Recurring rules project the published convention; future exceptional closures still require announced-schedule maintenance.
